target._source: plan rev3 A7: KB-level mean of the A2 curated (site partition, m = 4) gain over the KB's cells (O) and draws; d' vs abs (main), dAUROC (secondary; added after the RQ1 scale finding, JOURNAL 2026-10-06). Both A3 taus (0.01, inf). Test queries only. G (plan secondary) is not used: G is undefined or unstable near the ceiling (analysis rev3 sec.5); dA replaces it

predictors._source: analysis rev3 RQ5 list (cross-corpus score correlation = core; KB internal spread; ID-general-corpus similarity; site question count; query-doc gap), ID calibration queries (500 per KB) only, no OOD query. Defined (our choices, fixed before the run; the form is post hoc informed by A5 05_offdiag): pi_var = mean over the KB's A2 m = 4 site sets of 1/sqrt(1 + r^2 - 2 rho r) - 1, r = SD_cal(c)/SD_cal(s_KB), rho = corr_cal(s_KB, c), c = comparison term at tau (noise-cancellation factor of the moment identity, ID-only); rho = its mean; d_hat = mean_cal(s_KB - mean over the other banks of s_j) / SD_cal(s_KB) (ID-only separation proxy); theory = pi_var * d_hat (the T_var term with d_abs replaced by d_hat; parameter-free). Simple: log_n = log questions kept for the site (A0); sd_kb, mu_kb = SD / mean of s_KB on calibration queries (spread; query-bank similarity level = query-doc gap proxy); gen = mean top-10 cosine of calibration queries to the MS MARCO 50k pool (P9, same retriever); crowd = mean over calibration queries of the maximum over other banks of s_j (KB-near comparison cost proxy). Comparison sets are the KB's A2 sets (known at deployment; they exclude O by construction)

models._source: our choices, fixed before the run: M0 = theory predictor, no fitting; M1 = leave-one-KB-out OLS on standardised [pi_var, d_hat, crowd] (theory components + cost proxy); M2 = LOKO OLS on all 8 (exploratory); baselines = LOKO OLS on each simple predictor alone (sign learned in the training fold). Standardisation inside each training fold

judgment: analysis rev3 RQ5 + completion (fixed before the run): statistic = Spearman across KBs between the (LOKO) prediction and the observed KB-level gain; a model beats the simple baselines if the KB-bootstrap 95% interval of Spearman(model) - max over simple baselines of Spearman(baseline) (max taken within each replicate) lies above 0. Read on the primary run (86 KBs); the 30-KB subset runs are descriptive. Failure to beat the baselines = refutation for RQ5 (exploratory RQ)

other_banks._source: review 2026-10-06 (major 2): crowd and d_hat must not use the KB's out-of-scope sites' banks (A2 excludes O from comparison sets). Main run: strict = banks that are no O of this KB (73 of 85); subset runs (every other site is an O of the KB): per cell exclude that cell's O and average over cells (still uses other cells' O banks; descriptive runs only). pi_var uses the A2 sets, which exclude O

primary._source: review 2026-10-06 (major 4), fixed before the run, our choice: the parameter-free theory predictor on the main target (d') is the test of record, each tau read separately (as A3: no single sign when the taus disagree); M1 / M2 and dA are secondary
